svg.title: AUPRC heatmap for all primary model-by-task slices and monitoring methods
svg.text: No monitoring method dominates across settings
Each cell reports AUPRC, then precision (P) and recall (R) at the matched firing rate
Methods are grouped by taxonomy and sorted by mean AUPRC; Frozen quiz is excluded
Active wins 3/7 slices; passive or baseline methods win 4/7
